sections.title: Executive Overview: 2026 Practice Shifts
sections.content: The March 2026 literature highlights a definitive move from reactive to proactive disease management. Key themes include the 'Interventional Glaucoma' paradigm, the standardization of AI-driven 'autonomous' screening for diabetic retinopathy, and the emergence of non-viral gene delivery platforms. We are seeing a stabilization of biosimilar adoption in retina, leading to significant cost-savings and expanded access to care.

sections.title: Retina: Geographic Atrophy (GA) Therapeutics
content: Pegcetacoplan (Syfovre) Long-term Data: Confirmed 3-year safety profile with sustained foveal sparing.
Avacincaptad pegol (Izervay): Post-hoc analysis shows 25% reduction in vision loss risk when started early.
Sustained Release: Phase III results of subconjunctival complement inhibitors show 6-month durability.
Non-viral Gene Therapy: First human trials of episomal delivery systems for Factor H show promising expression levels.

sections.title: Red Flags: Intravitreal Injection Complications
content: Severe Pain & Vision Loss: Acute Endophthalmitis (Emergent Tap/Inject)
Painless 'Floaters' post-steroid: Iatrogenic Cataract or Vitreous Heme
Non-infectious IOI: Brolucizumab-associated Vasculitis (Check peripheral vessels)
Acute IOP Spike: Retained silicone oil or steroid-induced response

sections.title: Landmark Study: THE GENESIS TRIAL (2025-2026)
sections.content: The GENESIS Trial published in March 2026 Ophthalmology® established that CRISPR/Cas9-based RCE (Retinal Cell Engineering) for Leber Congenital Amaurosis (LCA) achieved a 3-line gain in ETDRS letters in 68% of participants. This study represents the first successful large-scale 'in-vivo' gene editing result in humans, marking a pivotal moment for ophthalmic genetics.

sections.title: Management Algorithm: Modern Myopia Control
content: Step 1: Axial Length Measurement & Baseline Refraction (Cycloplegic)
Step 2: Risk Assessment (Parental history, outdoor time, near-work)
Step 3: First-line: Low-dose Atropine (0.05% preferred over 0.01%)
Step 4: Adjunctive: DIMS (Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments) glasses
Step 5: Alternative/Tertiary: Orthokeratology (Rigid Gas Permeable lenses)
Step 6: Monitoring: 6-month Axial Length checks (Goal <0.1mm/year growth)

sections.title: Cornea: Endothelial Replacement Advances
content: DSO (Descemet Stripping Only): Success rates reaching 85% with topical Rho-kinase (ROCK) inhibitors.
Cultured Endothelial Cell Injection: 24-month follow-up shows cell density >1200 cells/mm² without donor tissue.
Synthetic Endothelial Implants: Polymer-based membranes entering Phase II trials for Fuch's Dystrophy.
E-DMEK: Automated Descemet Membrane stripping using robotic femtosecond platforms.

sections.title: Diagnostic Accuracy: AI vs. Board-Certified Retina Specialists
Surgical Pearl: Robot-Assisted ILM Peeling
content: Tremor Filtration: 2026 robotic platforms (e.g., Preceyes Gen 2) reduce physiological tremor by 99%.
Force Feedback: New 'haptic sensors' allow the surgeon to feel the tension on the ILM, reducing retinal trauma.
Staining protocol: Dual-staining (Brilliant Blue + ICG) now standard for secondary ERM/ILM identification.
Speed: Total surgical time for robotic ILM peel is now non-inferior to manual peeling.

sections.title: Clinical Pearls for Resident Boards (2026)
content: Always check the 'Fellow Eye' in GA; it is the best predictor of progression rate.
The 'Water-Shed' zone of the optic nerve is most susceptible to NAION during nocturnal hypotension.
Don't confuse 'Schlossman-Posner' (high IOP/few cells) with acute angle closure (high IOP/no angle).
Aflibercept 8mg (Eylea HD) allows for Q12-16 week dosing in 40% of patients with wet AMD.

sections.title: Recent Advances: The 'Bionic' Eye 2.0
sections.content: Subretinal photovoltaic arrays (e.g., Prima System) have now demonstrated the ability to restore reading speeds of 40-50 words per minute in patients with advanced GA. Unlike previous epiretinal models, this system leverages remaining bipolar cells for natural processing.
